logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-04 verification memo: a clean energy-ladder chart for the four candidate robot cell packages on the shared acceptance-batch basis. Horizontal axis lists P1, P3, P2, P4 in energy order; vertical axis is measured energy in kWh per fixed packaging acceptance batch, bars at 6, 14, 40 and 67. A dashed horizontal reference line marks the P1 minimum at 6 kWh. Consecutive gap callouts annotate +8, +26 and +27 kWh between adjacent bars; secondary labels give levels versus the minimum (1x, 2.33x, 6.67x, 11.17x). Small chips under each bar show quality index and raw defect count (P1 98/1, P3 89/1, P2 86/5, P4 100/5) with headroom color-coding: green for 1/5 (four defects of headroom), red for 5/5 (zero headroom). A bottom strip states the policy result: all four qualify (quality at least 80, defects at most 5), lowest energy wins, P1 selected. Style: flat vector, sans-serif, high contrast, no decorative filler; suitable as a technical decision-support figure for a verification memo.
